WHAT IT IS

A snapshot,
frozen on deadline day.

Five Percent is Spider Paint as it stood when the competition closed: the same 3Draft engine, the same first-person workshop, plus a VR mode and a story. Spider Paint keeps evolving; Five Percent stays as it was submitted.

3DRAFT

The engine

HEXAW-powered core, one material per face, WebGPU, WebGL2 and SVG.

SPIDER PAINT

The workshop

Model where you stand, target anything, shoot prisms, string spider bars, carve with booleans.

FIVE PERCENT

The journey

Real star positions, galaxies and black holes, a starship with the SNP drive, and VR crew training.

THE STORY

Speed is
no problem.

On the Wyoming WU-3463 space station, the company UP — Unseen Physics — has built the SNP drive: Speed No Problem. A crew is being assembled for the starship 7th Quadrant. Before they leave, they train in the LARK-4C simulation for the problems that may wait for them at the far points of the universe.

There is no hyperspace jump. Every SNP level multiplies the speed, so you feel the real distances: from a moon to a neighbouring star to another galaxy, without changing engines or controls.

11days of building, mostly vibe-coded in Hungarian
3days for VR, on a rented headset
1000galaxies, 400 black holes, ~3000 nearby stars
746recorded steps in the LARK build replay

HOW TO PLAY IN VR

Bare hands.
No controllers.

Built for Meta Quest 3 through WebXR. Hand tracking does everything; controllers are ignored.

  1. Enter VR from the Quest Browser

    Open five-percent-3draft.vercel.app on the headset and choose the VR button. Put the controllers down.

  2. Meet ViRTuSH

    Each hand has fixed functions. Pick a function by touching an icon on the back of your other hand.

  3. Move and build

    Walk the scene, then build: pick materials, grab objects, place cubes and walls, cut with the saw, type and sketch in the air — with undo.

  4. Fly the LARK-4C

    Throttle, targeting and a holographic dashboard. Lock onto a star or a black hole and let the SNP drive brake you at its surface.

  5. Watch the stories

    Scene and story modes, including the full LARK build replay: an AI built the shuttle step by step, and you can pause, scrub and step through it.

  6. No headset? No problem.

    Five Percent also runs on desktop (keyboard and mouse) and on phones (touch pad), each with its own controls.

Seven hours of black screen

With no VR experience and a headset rented three days before the deadline, the first VR session rendered nothing. The cause, found with a live debugging tool built together with Claude: a controller component returned null, and the engine treated it as fatal. The debug panel is still in the app, behind the bug icon.
